title: OceanVeil Adds Yomu's Miru Tights Short Anime Series
content:
WWWave Corporation 's anime streaming platform OceanVeil announced on Tuesday that it is adding the Miru Tights web anime on Thursday at 9:00 p.m. EDT. OceanVeil describes the anime:

Created by legendary illustrator Yom , famous for their obsessive, hyper-realistic depiction of pantyhose aesthetics, Miru Tights is an unashamed celebration of legwear in all its glory. Whether you are a fan of 30-denier sheer elegance, 60-denier matte allure, or the heartbreaking drama of a sudden snag in a thread, OceanVeil invites you to indulge your sophisticated tastes without judgment.

The anime debuted on the Nico Nico Channel and d Anime Store services in May 2019. The official YouTube channel for the anime also streamed the episodes with English subtitles, as well as Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese subtitles. The anime streamed 12 five-minute episodes, and the anime's Blu-ray Disc release in Japan included a bonus 13th episode (the release also included the same subtitle language support as the streaming release).

Yūki Ogawa ( Ōya-san wa Shishunki! ) directed the anime at Yokohama Animation Lab and Fumiaki Maruto ( White Album 2 visual novel, Classroom Crisis , Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend ) wrote the series. Yukari Hibino designed the characters, and SHADE composed the music. The three cast members each sang their own solo version of the anime's ending theme song "True Days" as their respective characters.

Yomu / Yom , an illustrator whose work typically focuses on women in tights, wrote the original story.

The author's Ganbare Dōki-chan (You Can Do It Dōki-chan) dōjinshi manga also inspired a net anime adaptation that debuted on the ABEMA streaming service in Japan in September 2021. Crunchyroll streamed the anime.

title: Canceled HBO Max Series is Coming to Toonami
content:
In the era of streaming, it seems as though there is so much content out there that subscribers might feel like they can never catch up. Unfortunately, this same benefit can mean that some animated series can be lost in the shuffle. In 2023, Warner Bros added a thought-provoking, stunning show to its HBO Max catalogue that only received one season, much to the chagrin of many viewers. Following its series finale on the streaming service, the show would find new life on Netflix, and now, the animated alien world filled with scavengers is making its way to Cartoon Network’s Toonami in a wild twist.

Beginning next month, on September 5th, Scavengers Reign will arrive on Toonami, which is good news for many fans of the now-defunct series. The series, which focuses on an unfortunate crew stranded on a beautiful but deadly alien world, recently left Netflix earlier this year after a short-lived stint on the streaming service. Ever since the show was originally canceled, many fans have been trying to start a campaign to see the show revived with new seasons. While the efforts so far have been unsuccessful, there’s always the possibility that Scavengers Reign’s Toonami reign could be just what the animated show needs to make a comeback. You can see the announcement with a new trailer below.

Will Scavengers Reign Return?

The true tragedy of Scavengers Reign was that the creators of this unique animated series did have ideas for what the future would look like for the series. In a conversation with us here at ComicBook.com back in 2023 , executive producers Sean Buckelew and James Merrill explained that while the first season was meant to be one complete story, they had mapped out future seasons. Merrill confirmed, “I do feel like we tried to tell a complete story, not a puzzle box that tries to lure people back. That being said, we do have some big ideas as to what could come next. I hope that we get to do it because we want to explore what comes next. We only saw a little bit of the planet.”

Buckelew added that the duo had planned for multiple seasons in the future , though the possibility of this happening now seems far less likely. “We have a couple more seasons mapped out and have some very developed ideas for next season should we get to make more. Fingers crossed because we’d like to spend more time with these characters and really see what else the planet has up its sleeve.” Luckily, if you haven’t had the chance to check out this unique animated series and don’t want to wait until next month, Scavengers Reign is still on HBO Max.

title: One Piece Manga Tops Oricon's Monthly Comic Ranking for July 2026
content:
The 115th volume of Eiichiro Oda 's One Piece manga ranked at #1 selling 1,020,422 copies. The volume shipped in Japan on July 3. The One Piece manga has surpassed 600 million copies published worldwide as of the release of the 114th volume on March 4. The One Piece anime's Elbaph arc debuted in Japan on April 5. Crunchyroll is streaming the arc, and will stream the English dub this fall.

The 39th volume of Yoshihiro Togashi 's Hunter X Hunter manga ranked at #2. The latest volume, its first volume in 22 months, shipped in Japan on July 3. The manga resumed serialization on June 29.

The 17th volume of Nekokurage 's manga adaptation of Hyuganatsu 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novels ranked at #3. Nekokurage launched the manga in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in May 2017. Square Enix Manga publishes the series in English.

The top 20 compiled print volumes of manga or comics in Japan in July 2026, according to Oricon, were:

About ORICON:

ORICON is a company that provides rankings and news. Since 1967, it has been compiling data on record sales in Japan and publishing rankings; since 2008, it has also published the “ORICON Book Ranking” based on sales figures. The company holds a vast amount of data on the Japanese entertainment market. It operates “ORICON NEWS,” Japan's largest entertainment website, and runs “Japan Anime News” as its global version.

title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered Anime Casts Sora Amamiya
content:
The staff for the anime of Kentarou 's From Overshadowed to Overpowered ( Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musō: Nidome no Tensei, S-Rank Cheat Majutsushi Bōkenroku ) manga revealed on Thursday that the anime has cast Sora Amamiya as the character Tatiana, Anastasia's older sister. The character will appear in the anime's eighth episode on August 19.

The anime premiered on the d Anime Store , ABEMA , and U-NEXT streaming services in Japan on June 25 at 24:00 (effectively, June 26 at midnight). It then started on the Tokyo MX channel on July 1 at 24:00 (effectively, July 2 at midnight), and also runs on ABC TV, BS Fuji , and WOWOW in Japan. Crunchyroll streams the anime simultaneously with the Japanese stream.

The anime stars:

• Shūichirō Umeda as Ephtal

• Reo Osanai as Anastasia

• Haruka Shiraishi as Marin

• Hiroki Tōchi as Ephtal (as a sage and old man)

• Ayaka Fukuhara as Ephtal (as a youth)

• Emiri Katō as Iria

• Daisuke Hirakawa as Fraser

• Shinichirō Kamio as Abe

• Rina Kawaguchi as Maria

• Hiroki Takahashi as Majin (Genie)

Hisashi Ishii ( Kuma Kuma Kuma Bear , I'm Quitting Heroing , The Unaware Atelier Master ) is directing the anime at EMT Squared , with Deko Akao ( Higehiro , Komi Can't Communicate , Flying Witch ) supervising the series' scripts. Hideki Furukawa ( WATAMOTE , Strike The Blood III onward, Ayakashi Triangle ) is designing the characters.

Rock band FLOW performs the opening theme song "+Encount," and the group TrySail is performing the anime's ending theme song "Dōkei" (Aspiration).

Comikey is releasing the manga in English, and it is also available through Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service. Comikey describes the manga's story:

Ephtal is reincarnated as a human, coming from modern Earth. In this new world where magic is real, he decides to devote the entirety of his life in the pursuit of magic. Despite his efforts, though, he discovers that he is absolutely talentless in magic, and breathed his last in anguish....But it isn't the end for him just yet! He reincarnates once again bearing the same name, Ephtal, 400 years later. Having retained his knowledge and power, he steels his resolve and once again sets his sights for the peak of magic!

The manga is itself based on Arata Shiraishi 's Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musō: Nido Tensei Shita Saikyō Kenja, 400-nen-go no Sekai o Maken de Musō light novel series. The anime is adapting Kentarou 's manga, and specifically uses the manga's slightly different title.

Kentarou launched the manga in Square Enix 's Manga UP! website in September 2019. Square Enix published the manga's ninth compiled book volume on July 7.

Arata Shiraishi originally published the story in a web novel format, before Kadokawa published the first print volume in October 2019, with illustrations by uodenim . Kadokawa published the eighth novel volume in March 2022.

title: Tenkaichi: The Greatest Warrior Under the Rising Sun First Trailer Reveals Main Staff and Cast
content:
Tenkaichi: The Greatest Warrior Under the Rising Sun anime revealed its first trailer and a new visual, along with an April 2027 release date. The anime was announced in April 2025.

Studio Fugaku is in charge of the animation production, with Masashi Abe as the director, Kazuharu Sato in charge of the series composition, Ryoji Nakamori as the character design, and music by Hayato Matsuo. The main voice cast includes:

• Gen Sato as Miyamoto Musashi

• Kenichiro Matsuda as Honda Tadakatsu

• Kenyu Horiuchi as Oda Nobunaga

You can hear the cast in the trailer below.

You can also see the three characters in the teaser visual.

Tenkaichi: The Greatest Warrior Under the Rising Sun (Tenkaichi: Nihon Saikyo Bugeisha Ketteisen) is a manga series written by Yosuke Nakamaru and illustrated by Kyotaro Azuma. It first debuted in January 2021 in Young Magazine the 3rd , published by Kodansha . Following the discontinuation of that magazine, the series was moved to Monthly Young Magazine in May of the same year. Kodansha describes the story:

This is not history as we know it. The year is 1600. Ten years have passed since Oda Nobunaga unified the whole of Japan. When Nobunaga realizes he is nearing the end of his life, he announces that he will hand over the reins of power to whoever brings him the strongest warrior. The generals, whose dreams of conquering the country had been crushed, put up their own strongest warriors and aim to become the king of the country! The first match is peerless spear wielder Honda Tadakatsu (sponsored by Tokugawa Ieyasu) vs. evolving prodigy Miyamoto Musashi (sponsored by Chosokabe Motochika)!!

title: Rudy Meets Perugius in Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 8 Preview
content:
Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 8 preview images and synopsis ahead of its August 16 premiere. The episode is set to begin the Chaos Breaker arc , which recently revealed a trailer. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup .

Episode 8 is titled “The Flying Fortress,” and you can see the preview images and synopsis below.

To find a way to restore Zenith, Rudeus, through an introduction from Nanahoshi, is granted an audience with Perugius, the “Armored Dragon King,” one of the Three Heroes who slew the Demon God and now resides in the floating fortress Chaos Breaker. After hearing about Zenith, the overwhelmingly imposing Perugius unexpectedly mentions the name of a certain person.

The main staff for the anime was previously announced and includes:

• Director: Ryosuke Shibuya

• Character Design: Sanae Shimada, Ryota Furukawa

• Music: Yoshiaki Fujisawa

• Studio: Studio Bind

You can also check out the teaser trailer for the upcoming arc below.

Season 3 began with Volume 14, for which Seven Seas describes the story: Nanahoshi, Rudeus, and the rest of their group take a trip to Perugius’s mysterious floating fortress, seeking adventure and a once-in-a-lifetime chance to learn new magic. What they find instead is disaster as one of their number is struck down by a deadly illness. How far will Rudeus go to save a dear friend’s life?

You can also see the key visual for the third season.

The anime is based on a light novel by Rifujin na Magonote with Shirotaka’s illustrations. Seven Seas is publishing the light novel in English. The series is also launching a game titled Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation – Chronicle of Echoes this year. It is a free-to-play game with in-app purchases developed by ASOBIMO.

content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of artist Kyōtarō Azuma and author Yōsuke Nakamaru 's Tenkaichi: The Greatest Warrior Under the Rising Sun ( Tenkaichi: Nihon Saikyō Bugeisha Ketteisen ) manga opened on Thursday and revealed the anime's teaser promotional video, teaser visual, main cast and staff members, and April 2027 debut.

The anime will star ( historical Japanese characters' names are rendered family name first ):

Gen Sato as Miyamoto Musashi

Kenichirō Matsuda as Honda Tadakatsu

Kenyū Horiuchi as Oda Nobunaga

Masashi Abe ( Casshan: Robot Hunter Casshern , Tokko , Magical Canan ) is directing the anime at Fugaku . Kazuharu Sato ( Colorful , Papillon Rose ) is in charge of series scripts, Ryōji Nakamori ( Hellsing Ultimate , Peleliu: Guernica of Paradise film) is designing the characters, and Hayato Matsuo ( Heaven's Design Team , Hellsing Ultimate ) is composing the music.

Kodansha 's K MANGA service is publishing the manga simultaneously in English, and it describes the story:

This is not history as we know it. The year is 1600. Ten years have passed since Oda Nobunaga unified the whole of Japan. When Nobunaga realizes he is nearing the end of his life, he announces that he will hand over the reins of power to whoever brings him the strongest warrior. The generals, whose dreams of conquering the country had been crushed, put up their own strongest warriors and aim to become the king of the country! The first match is peerless spear wielder Honda Tadakatsu (sponsored by Tokugawa Ieyasu) vs. evolving prodigy Miyamoto Musashi (sponsored by Chosokabe Motochika)!!

The manga launched in Kodansha 's Young Magazine the 3rd magazine in January 2021. The manga moved to Monthly Young Magazine in May 2021 after Young Magazine the 3rd ended publication. Kodansha will publish the manga's 14th compiled book volume on August 20.

title: 'Tenkaichi' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo, Spring 2027 Premiere
content:
An official website opened for the television anime adaptation of Yousuke Nakamaru and Kyoutarou Azuma 's Tenkaichi: Nihon Saikyou Bugeisha Ketteisen ( Tenkaichi: The Greatest Warrior Under the Rising Sun ) manga revealed the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video on Thursday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in April 2027.

Cast Musashi Miyamoto: Gen Satou ( Dr. Stone ) Tadakatsu Honda: Kenichirou Matsuda ( Ryoumin 0-nin Start no Henkyou Ryoushu-sama ) Nobunaga Oda: Kenyuu Horiuchi ( Dorohedoro )

Staff Director: Masashi Abe ( MF Ghost episode director) Series Composition: Kazuharu Satou ( Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works script) Character Design: Ryouji Nakamori ( Drifters ) Music: Hayato Matsuo ( Tenchi Souzou Design-bu ) Studio: Fugaku

Nakamaru and Azuma originally began the samurai action manga in Young Magazine the 3rd in January 2021. Following the merger of the magazine into Monthly Young Magazine three months later, the manga resumed in the latter in May that year. Kodansha published the 13th volume on February 19, with the 14th volume scheduled to go on sale on August 20.

Kodansha's K Manga app and website simulpublishes the manga in English. The manga is also published in Italian by Star Comics.

Tenkaichi was nominated for the 8th Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Taisho (Next Manga Award) in the Print category in 2022.

Nakamaru and Azuma originally began the samurai action manga in Young Magazine the 3rd in January 2021. Following the merger of the magazine into Monthly Young Magazine three months later, the manga resumed in the latter in May that year. Kodansha published the 13th volume on February 19, with the 14th volume scheduled to go on sale on August 20.
Kodansha's K Manga app and website simulpublishes the manga in English. The manga is also published in Italian by Star Comics.
Tenkaichi was nominated for the 8th Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Taisho (Next Manga Award) in the Print category in 2022.

title: Houston Man Charged For Terroristic Threat Over Anime
content:
A man from Houston, Texas has been charged with a third-degree felony count of terroristic threat against a public servant after allegedly leaving a profanity-ridden voicemail to the Governor's Office related to anime. According to the local KXAN station, the voicemail stated (profanity has been partially redacted in the below quote):

I don't know which one of you sons of b—-es passed this motherf—ing bill to get this damn s— blocking my motherf—ing anime, but you whole a– motherf—ers need to unpass this s—. Y'all are f—ing ridiculous with your b—- a–es. My Google account says I'm f—ing over the age of 18, and your dumba– is passing these dumba– laws. I'm a f—ing stab every godd— one of you b—-es. Unlock my f—ing anime.

A Texas Department of Public Safety agent wrote in an affidavit that the call was made from a cell phone registered to 35-year-old Joseph Roy Ozment on July 25. The DPS said that the Governor's Office employee was in fear of the lives of himself, his coworkers, and the general public at the office.

Ozment faces a possible 10 years in prison and US$10,000 in fines if convicted.

It remains unclear what bill Ozment is referring to in his voicemail, but related laws may include: a 2023 Texas law that required adult websites to verify a site visitor's age before allowing access, which led to some sites blocking access to devices from Texas; or the recently passed Texas Senate Bill 2420 , which requires app stores (such as Apple 's App Store or Google Play ) to similarly verify a user's age before allowing downloads.

Popular anime streaming sites, such as Crunchyroll and HIDIVE , remain available in Texas.

title: 'Kinsou no Vermeil' Manga Artist Youko Umezu Dies
content:
Manga artist Youko Umezu , best known as the illustrator for Kouta Amana 's Kinsou no Vermeil ( Vermeil in Gold ) manga, died on July 7 due to a cerebral infarction. A funeral service was held by her close relatives.

The editorial department of Monthly Shounen Gangan announced the news on Wednesday, stating that this sudden farewell must have been unexpected for the artist herself, making it a truly heartbreaking event for her family, the editorial staff, and everyone involved.

"We would like to respectfully inform our readers, who have supported her work during her lifetime. All members of the editorial department express our deepest respect and gratitude for her artistic work and offer our heartfelt condolences," the editorial team added.

Kinsou no Vermeil ended with its 41st chapter that was serialized in the July issue on June 12. The editors added that the details for future volume releases will be announced at a later date.

Amana and Umezu began the school fantasy manga in Monthly Shounen Gangan in August 2018. Square Enix released the 11th volume on June 11.

Staple Entertainment adapted the manga into a 12-episode anime series in Summer 2022. Sentai Filmworks licensed the anime and streamed it on HIDIVE with subtitles and an English dub.
